name: read-claude-web-conversation
description: >- Reads or exports the COMPLETE transcript of a Claude.ai web conversation — private /chat/... and public /share/... links — via Claude.ai's internal API in the user's logged-in Chrome, plus its files. Use when the user pastes a claude.ai link and asks to read, summarize, export, archive, or extract it — "读这个对话", "导出网页版对话", "拉到本地". Local sessions: read-claude-code-history; exported files: claude-export-txt-better.
author: daymade
